Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its Meeting held on May 30, 2005 have interalia approved of investment of a sum not exceeding Rs.140 crores in Mahindra Automotive Steels Private Limited (MASPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, in one or more tranches, to enable MASPL to acquire the controls and crankshaft machining facilities and other balancing machines and to fund its acquisition and growth plans in the auto component business.Besides the Board of Directors of MASPL at its meeting held on May 30, 2005 have approved of a proposal involving interalia the merger of Chakan Unit of Amforge Industries Limited (AIL) being demerged from AIL into MASPL, subject to necessary approvals being obtained.At the said Board Meeting, the Board of MASPL also approved of appointments of Legal Advisor(s), Valuer(s) etc. for finalising the Scheme of Arrangement, valuation of the Chakan Undertaking of AIL and determining the appropriate terms of the merger including consideration thereof.
